title: User and System Bot
description: The user talks only with the overall System Bot. System Bot accepts the build request, tracks the PM, Foreman council, and 100-worker pool run, then returns the final package.

messages.text: Start a run from workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png. Target: build the visible Tiantan structure in Minecraft and write all generated files under workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001.

messages.systemLog: Route message: User submits the image path and output target to System Bot.

messages.text: Received the build request. I will create the work directory and open a Project Manager channel for planning.

messages.systemLog: Send message: System Bot forwards the build request and image path to Project Manager.

messages.text: Project Manager has prepared the blueprint and the Foreman-A to Foreman-E plan. The 100 workers are now grouped into five synchronized worker-pool rooms.

messages.systemLog: Update status: Project Manager reports that the blueprint and five Foreman worker pools are ready.

messages.text: Run complete. Final outputs include final_world.schem, report.json, replay.jsonl, and a tarball containing the raw execution logs.

messages.systemLog: Package result: System Bot returns the final schematic, reports, replay file, and compressed log archive to the user.
